abstract: The ability of leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) to block differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells under a variety of induction conditions was determined. LIF inhibits differentiation under several conditions which lead to endodermal and mesodermal cell lineages including skeletal and cardiac muscle. In contrast, LIF does not block differentiation when cells are induced under conditions which lead to neuro-ectodermal cell types including neurons and astroglial cells. These studies demonstrate that P19 EC cell differentiation can be divided into LIF sensitive and insensitive pathways which correlate with differentiation of endodermal/mesodermal and neuro-ectodermal cell types, respectively. The effect of LIF on mRNA levels for several genes which have previously been implicated in mediating differentiation in P19 EC cells was determined. LIF has no effect on the mRNA levels for retinoic acid receptor (RAR) alpha, RAR beta, RAR gamma, jun A, jun D, c-fos, or fra-1. In contrast LIF stimulates jun B mRNA expression by a factor of four to six under all induction conditions.
abstract_ja: P19胎児性癌(EC)細胞の分化を、様々な誘導条件下で白血病抑制因子(LIF)が阻害するかを検討した。LIFは内胚葉および中胚葉系譜（骨格筋・心筋を含む）へ至る条件下で分化を阻害したが、神経外胚葉系（ニューロン・アストログリア）へ至る条件下では阻害しなかった。よって、P19 EC細胞の分化はLIF感受性と非感受性の経路に分けられ、それぞれ内胚葉・中胚葉系と神経外胚葉系の分化に対応する。LIFは、P19 EC細胞の分化に関与するとされる遺伝子のmRNA量に与える影響も調べた。LIFはRARα、RARβ、RARγ、jun A、jun D、c-fos、fra-1のmRNA量には影響しなかったが、jun B mRNAは全ての誘導条件下で4〜6倍に増加させた。
